purpose: Minimal private-first web search and local content extraction for Pi agents through protocol provides.

provides.name: web_search
provides.description: Search through local-first SearXNG with optional configured Brave fallback. Supply query or 1-5 queries; results are compact and bounded.

inputSchema.description: Web search input. query must be non-empty, or queries must contain 1-5 non-empty strings.

max_results.description: Results per query from 1 to 20; defaults to 5.

provides.name: fetch_content
provides.description: Fetch and locally extract bounded readable content from a public HTTP(S) URL or PDF. Jina fallback is opt-in only.

quality_threshold.description: Extraction quality threshold from 0 to 100; defaults to 50.

force_jina.description: Force the opt-in Jina extractor; defaults to false.

max_chars.description: Maximum returned characters from 1 to 50000; defaults to 12000.
